profileLabel: Center-left economics (low-moderate confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Laguna 3rd District representative with about 17 principal-authored bills. Economic bills mix household tax relief (VAT on basic power and water, wider income-tax exemption), an alcohol excise hike, senior and nutrition-worker benefits, and tax-free deposit interest. Co-authored the national minimum wage. No social, civil-liberties or institutions evidence found.
caveat: Bill-list evidence only; tax-relief bills do not alone establish left orientation, so the score is modest. No votes or statements reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Tax relief on basic power, water and income (mildly redistributive) and an alcohol excise rise; senior and nutrition-worker benefits; co-authored minimum wage (-2 each). Counterweight: tax-free long-term deposit interest (+2). Mixed pattern, slight left lean.
